en: A vintage printed postcard showing a large Gothic-style church with tall arched windows and a prominent entrance portal opening onto an empty square. The church has steep slate roofs, a richly ornamented tower rising behind the main body, and a small side structure with its own pointed roof. The colors are softly tinted, suggesting a hand-colored or early color-print postcard. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a church in Nijmegen.
